routes.label: urgent, within 3 working days as the Department aims

note: Fees from 2 May 2025 (the Passport (Fees) Amendment Regulations 2025), GST included; the urgent price is the passport's plus the urgent service fee of $247, as 1News reported the Department's announcement (the regulations on legislation.govt.nz and passports.govt.nz answer this client with a bot check, not read). The standard processing time and the fees for applying from abroad are leads; the after-hours call-out service ($754 more) isn't modelled.

sources.title: Govt.nz (New Zealand Government), Get or renew a New Zealand passport
sources.said: If you are 16 or older, you need an adult passport. Adult passports cost $247 and are valid for 10 years. Child passports Child passports are for children aged 15 and under. Child passports cost $144 and are valid for 5 years. ... We aim to process applications for urgent processing within 3 working days, but this can depend on demand and factors such as complete information and a photo that meets the standards.

sources.title: Department of Internal Affairs, Passport fees to increase from 2 May (1 May 2025)
sources.said: From 2 May 2025, the price of an adult passport will increase from $215 to $247, and the price of a child passport from $125 to $144 (incl. GST).

sources.title: 1News, Price of New Zealand passport to increase (1 May 2025)
sources.said: The urgent service fee would increase from $215 to $247, bringing the total cost for an urgent passport to $494 for adults and $391 for children.
